_comment: Copy to dsh-blender.config.json to take effect; every key can be omitted (omitted = auto-detect/default). See docs/configuration-reference.md for details
_WSL_note: Running DSH inside WSL while Blender is on Windows: set blenderExe to /mnt/d/.../blender.exe, and give workDir a Windows drive-letter path (it is mapped to /mnt/d/... automatically)
